tools.name: kr_day_info
tools.description: For one date in Korea: weekday, weekend, public holiday name (Korean and English), and whether it is a business day.

tools.name: kr_holidays
tools.description: List Korean public holidays (관공서 공휴일) between two dates, including substitute holidays (대체공휴일).

tools.name: kr_business_days_between
tools.description: Count business days in Korea between two dates, both inclusive (weekends and public holidays excluded).

tools.name: kr_add_business_days
tools.description: The date that is N business days after (or before, if negative) a date in Korea. The start date itself is not counted. Use for deadlines like 'within 5 business days'.
